notes: 3 photos, all printed menu boards for the same 3-location chain (Chula Vista x2, San Diego). Photo 3 is the other side (Carnitas/Quesadillas/Extras/Bebidas). Skipped add-on modifiers (Solo Maciza, Con Buche, Con Lengua, Pata, handmade-tortilla upcharge).
